sql_calls.sql:
SELECT p.sku, p.name, p.price_inr, p.cost_inr,
       COALESCE(SUM(d.units_sold),0) AS total_units_sold,
       COALESCE(SUM(d.revenue_inr),0) AS total_revenue_inr,
       COALESCE(SUM(d.units_sold) * p.cost_inr,0) AS total_cost_inr,
       COALESCE(SUM(d.revenue_inr) - SUM(d.units_sold) * p.cost_inr,0) AS gross_profit_inr
FROM store.products p
LEFT JOIN store.daily_sales d ON p.sku = d.sku
WHERE d.date >= '2026-06-01' AND d.date <= '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY p.sku, p.name, p.price_inr, p.cost_inr
ORDER BY gross_profit_inr DESC;

SELECT p.sku, p.name, sa.audit_ts::date AS audit_date, d.date AS sales_date, d.units_sold, f.forecast_units_per_day,
       CASE WHEN sa.status = 'empty' THEN f.forecast_units_per_day - COALESCE(d.units_sold,0) ELSE 0 END AS estimated_lost_units,
       CASE WHEN sa.status = 'empty' THEN (f.forecast_units_per_day - COALESCE(d.units_sold,0)) * p.cost_inr ELSE 0 END AS lost_profit_inr
FROM store.daily_sales d
JOIN store.products p ON d.sku = p.sku
JOIN store.forecasts f ON d.sku = f.sku AND d.date::date = f.date::date
LEFT JOIN store.shelf_audits sa ON p.sku = sa.sku AND d.date::date = sa.audit_ts::date
WHERE d.date >= '2026-06-01' AND d.date <= '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY estimated_lost_units DESC;
